label: Forward test, live since Oct 15, 2026
status_detail: Entry prices lock at the Oct 15, 2026 close. That session is not complete yet, so these books have no return.
entry_rule: Entry is the adjusted close on the first completed US cash session on or after 2026-10-15. A same-day bar is not that close until 21:00 UTC, which is after both the 20:00 UTC (EDT) and 21:00 UTC (EST) cash closes. The entry price is written once and is not revised if Yahoo later restates the historical print. Later marks divide that session's adjusted close by the frozen entry.
ambiguities: The forward test starts at the Oct 15, 2026 close. A same-day Yahoo bar before 21:00 UTC is an intraday print and is not the entry. Until that close exists, entry prices stay blank and the books have no return.

Annual books use the 2026 cohort chosen at the 2025-12-31 close. They are not re-ranked here. The backtest path from that rebalance through the last session before inception is not part of the forward return.

Point-in-time Best Returner and Top 5 Returners are their own sleeves, because their 2026 names differ from the current-list books. Biggest and Top 5 Biggest hold the same names in both universes on this cohort, so each cap rule has one sleeve.
TQQQ buy-and-hold is not in the forward test. The TQQQ book is the two-bullet sleeve.

The two-bullet book is frozen at the sleeve weights after the May 26, 2026 limit exit: SPY plus two BIL sleeves, and no TQQQ. It is not reset to 90/10. A new drawdown trigger after inception is not taken.
Top 5 Biggest holds both GOOGL and GOOG. Both share classes are in the S&P, and both ranked in the top five by approximated cap.

books.name: TQQQ Two-Bullet 90/10
books.derivation: Frozen sleeve mix of TQQQ Two-Bullet 90/10 at the 2026-10-14 backtest mark, not a new 90/10. On 2026-05-26 the cycle ended (Limit filled at 80.8000. Satellite cash is back in BIL. A new cycle can start next session.) Weights at that mark, which already drift because the sleeves are never rebalanced: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust 67.059%; Bullet 1 ProShares UltraPro QQQ 0.000%; Bullet 2 ProShares UltraPro QQQ 0.000%; Bullet 1 dry powder (Treasury-bill proxy) 25.716%; Bullet 2 dry powder (Treasury-bill proxy) 7.225%. This test marks those weights. It does not arm a new 50% or 80% drawdown trigger, and it does not buy TQQQ again. SPY and BIL use adjusted closes. A TQQQ sleeve with a non-zero weight would use the split-adjusted close, matching the backtest rule. The forward return starts at the Oct 15, 2026 close.
